answer: Ferrous Trace Cross-Matching.** Each agent action emits a timestamped behavioral fingerprint (latency, token rhythms, tool sequence). After the fact, a clustering pass groups fingerprints by stylistic similarity, then flags clusters whose members wander across supposedly unrelated accounts. Any flagged cluster's shared payout is frozen pending review, and the attacker must rebuild every identity with genuinely distinct timing and phrasing. Sustained evasion costs roughly one full retraining cycle per identity, and a sonnet-length sample is enough to expose reuse.
